name: Sarthak Industries Limited
about: Sarthak Industries Limited engages in the trading of agri and non agri-commodities in India. It operates through Cylinders and Merchant Trading segments. The Cylinders segment manufactures, sells, and repairs LPG cylinders. The Merchant Trading segment is involved in the trading of various commodities, materials, etc. The company was formerly known as Avanti LPG (India) Limited. Sarthak Industries Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Indore, India.
